editorial.blurb: Ruuthai's Kitchen is an authentic Thai gem tucked into a humble residential spot, where the warm hospitality and vibrant, well-executed flavors transport you straight to Thailand.
editorial.insiderTip: Don't skip the mussel pancake appetizer—staff recommends it as a must-try, and it's worth ordering early. Grab a lunch special for incredible value, and note that the place has no AC, so plan your visit for cooler months.

topDishes.note: Mussels burst with flavor in a light, crispy fried batter with fresh scallions and cilantro
Warming spices in the broth hit the spot, with tender meatballs and fresh vegetables
A beloved traditional Thai dessert, very nice and authentic
